title: Account Manager
description:
We're Convert Sail, an e-commerce conversion optimization agency. We work with Shopify brands spending $100K-$1M+/month on ads, and we move fast. Really fast.


We're looking for an Account Manager to own client relationships and project delivery. You'll manage 8-10 client accounts, coordinate landing page and funnel builds with our design and dev team, and be the main point of contact when clients need something.


This isn't a 9-5 role where you clock out and forget about work. When a client has a launch on Saturday, you're online. When a project is behind, you stay late to fix it. We ship fast, we work weekends when it matters, and most people flame out in the first 90 days because they can't handle the pace.


If that scares you, this isn't the role for you.


If that excites you, keep reading.


What you'll do:


  • Own 8-10 client relationships and make sure they're happy, on track, and renewing long-term
  • Manage day-to-day client communication and set clear expectations
  • Coordinate landing page and funnel projects with our design and dev team—keep timelines tight and make sure nothing slips
  • Proactively identify and solve client issues before they become fires
  • Track project progress in ClickUp and ensure deadlines are met
  • Help clients see ROI from our work so they stick around for 6-12+ months, not 2-3
  • Be available during USA business hours and occasionally on weekends when client launches require it


What we're looking for:


  • 2+ years of experience managing client accounts in a fast-paced agency, SaaS company, or startup
  • Fluent English speaker with strong written and verbal communication skills
  • You've worked in high-pressure environments before and didn't crack under the weight
  • You're organized, proactive, and don't need someone checking in on you every 2 hours
  • You don't let things fall through the cracks—you follow up, you track details, you close loops
  • Experience with project management tools like ClickUp, Asana, or similar
  • Comfortable working remotely, but you don't treat "remote" like "invisible"
  • Bonus: Experience with e-commerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization (not required, but helpful)


What we offer:


  • Compensation: $12/hour ($2,000+/month full-time) + performance bonuses (depending on experience)
  • Fully remote—work from anywhere as long as you're available US hours
  • Work with real scaling brands, not broke startups or tire-kickers
  • Small team, so you'll have real impact and visibility
  • You'll learn more in 6 months here than 2 years at a slow-moving corporate job
  • Opportunity to grow into a senior role as the agency scales


How to apply:


Don't send a resume first.


Record a 4-minute Loom video (free tool, Google it if you don't know it) and tell us:


  1. Why you want this job
  2. Why we should hire you
  3. A time you had to manage a difficult client situation and how you handled it


Then email the Loom link to:


Subject line must include the word BUILDER. If it doesn't, we'll assume you can't follow instructions and we won't read your application.


If you can't handle recording a 4-minute video, you definitely can't handle this role.

title: Remote Investment Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz


Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.


We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.


We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.


Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.


The Role


  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side.
  • Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion.
  • Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.


What You'll Bring


  • 5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents.
  • Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits.
  • Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds.
  • Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast;
    your documents still close cleanly.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.


Why Moritz


  • Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.


Frequently Asked Questions


How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?


Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.


What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?


Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.


Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?


No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.


How are co-counsel matched to client matters?


Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

title: Remote Commercial Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz


Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.


We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.


We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.


Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.


The Role


  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side.
  • Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes.
  • Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.


What You'll Bring


  • 5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination.
  • Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective.
  • Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise.
  • Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.


Why Moritz


  • Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.


Frequently Asked Questions


How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?


Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.


What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?


Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.


Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?


No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.


How are co-counsel matched to client matters?


Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Analista De Pessoas E Administração
description:

Com sede administrativa em Curitiba/PR e operação logística em Joinville/SC, trabalhamos com processos enxutos e uma estrutura organizacional compacta, composta por equipes de 5 a 10 pessoas. Atua de forma operacional, analítica e estratégica, garantindo a eficiência dos processos de recrutamento e seleção, administração de pessoal, desenvolvimento de pessoas, comunicação interna e apoio às lideranças. Ambiente: criar e preservar um ambiente organizado, saudável e produtivo, focando no bem-estar das pessoas para que tenham condições de entregar seu melhor desempenho;

Suporte Administrativo: assumir demandas administrativas que ainda não possuam responsável definido, garantindo sua correta execução, direcionamento ou incorporação à rotina da área quando necessário.

  • Organizar treinamentos, eventos corporativos e ações de engajamento;
  • Resolver e organizar demandas administrativas do dia a dia, garantindo continuidade operacional;
  • Garantir a organização e o bom funcionamento dos ambientes corporativos;
  • Estruturar, documentar e aprimorar processos internos sempre que necessário;
  • Atuar como ponto de apoio para lideranças e colaboradores em assuntos relacionados à gestão de pessoas e rotinas administrativas;
  • Monitorar indicadores da área e propor melhorias que contribuam para o desenvolvimento das equipes e da organização.

title: Analista De Instrumentação E Equipamentos De Testes
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Instrumentação e Equipamentos de Teste para atuar na gestão, calibração, manutenção e evolução tecnológica dos equipamentos de teste e de toda a cadeia de medição, incluindo sensores, cabos, conectores e sistemas de aquisição de dados.

Esse(a) profissional será uma referência técnica para engenheiros e técnicos, apoiando a seleção, configuração e utilização correta de instrumentação em bancadas e veículos. Também será responsável por assegurar a confiabilidade das medições, a disponibilidade dos equipamentos e a melhoria contínua do parque de testes.


RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida dos equipamentos de teste e instrumentação, incluindo inventário, criticidade, padrões, documentação e rastreabilidade.

  • Garantir a conformidade metrológica e a máxima disponibilidade dos sistemas de teste.
  • Diagnosticar falhas e realizar troubleshooting em sistemas de aquisição de dados, sensores, cabos, conectores e módulos de condicionamento de sinal.
  • Identificar e solucionar problemas relacionados a ruído, aterramento, interferência e integridade de sinal.
  • Configurar e comissionar sistemas de aquisição de dados e instrumentação de acordo com as necessidades dos testes.
  • Apoiar a montagem e a validação de setups de instrumentação em bancadas e veículos.
  • Definir, documentar e manter procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e padrões técnicos de instrumentação.
  • Estabelecer boas práticas de medição, montagem, inspeção, manuseio e armazenamento de sensores e equipamentos.
  • Treinar e suportar engenheiros e técnicos no uso correto e eficiente dos sistemas de medição.
  • Realizar análises de obsolescência e mapear necessidades futuras de equipamentos e tecnologias.
  • Elaborar roadmaps para atualização e expansão de data loggers, sensores e acessórios.
  • Apoiar solicitações de investimento e a seleção técnica de novos equipamentos.
  • Atuar como interface técnica com fornecedores e sites globais para alinhamento de tecnologias, métodos e requisitos locais.


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS


  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Eletrônica ou área correlata.
  • Experiência profissional entre 4 e 10 anos em equipamentos de teste, instrumentação, sistemas de medição, laboratórios de engenharia ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência prática com sensores de temperatura, pressão, aceleração e/ou strain gages.
  • Vivência com acessórios de instrumentação, cabeamento, conectores e condicionamento de sinais.
  • Conhecimento sólido dos fundamentos de metrologia e das rotinas de calibração.
  • Conhecimento sobre rastreabilidade metrológica, certificados, tolerâncias e gestão de intervalos de calibração.
  • Experiência com sistemas de aquisição de dados, incluindo configuração, instalação, comissionamento e troubleshooting.
  • Conhecimento sobre ruído, aterramento, blindagem e integridade de sinal.
  • Capacidade de organizar inventários, agendas, documentação e planos de manutenção.
  • Inglês avançado para leitura, escrita, conversação e interação com equipes globais e fornecedores.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação em Curitiba, Paraná .



DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência com equipamentos e soluções IPETRONIK .
  • Vivência com soluções HBM, National Instruments, Vector, ETAS ou plataformas similares.

  • Experiência em laboratórios de validação, testes automotivos, testes de durabilidade, NVH ou engenharia experimental.
  • Conhecimento de instrumentação e aquisição de dados em veículos.
  • Experiência com análise de obsolescência e elaboração de roadmaps tecnológicos.

title: Business Development & Marketing
description:
About iQIYI

iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.


Role purpose

Support iQIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.


Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70%

  • Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.
  • Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials.
  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions;
    final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.
  • Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30%

  • Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers.
  • Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects.
  • Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable.
  • Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.



Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects.
  • Fluent or native Portuguese.
  • Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills.
  • Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets;
    familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.


Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms.
  • Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America.
  • Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams.
  • Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models.
  • Mandarin Chinese.
  • Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.


Employment conditions and benefits

  • Permanent CLT employment agreement.
  • Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law.
  • Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance.
  • Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance.
  • 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law.
  • Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

No Brasil, nossa trajetória é marcada por crescimento sustentável, compromisso com a inovação e respeito às comunidades onde atuamos. Com unidades em diversas regiões do país, temos orgulho de impulsionar o desenvolvimento da agricultura brasileira, promovendo práticas mais eficientes e sustentáveis.


Nossa missão:

Gerar impacto positivo no mundo dos alimentos, agricultura e produtos industriais, avançando para um futuro sustentável para toda a humanidade.

Como fazemos isso:

Unimos nossos recursos naturais, a dedicação de uma equipe talentosa e nossa capacidade tecnológica para ampliar a produção de alimentos, garantir sua qualidade, viabilizar uma agricultura e uma produção industrial sustentáveis e proteger o meio ambiente.

  • Cuidado: Fazer o que é certo para nossos colaboradores, parceiros de negócios, acionistas, comunidades e meio ambiente.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Departamento Pessoal Pleno com experiência em processos de rescisão de alto volume , para atuar com autonomia na condução de todo o processo, desde a solicitação do desligamento até a sua conclusão.


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir processos de desligamento end to end ;
  • Receber e validar as solicitações de desligamento;
  • Conferir dados cadastrais, contratuais e históricos do empregado;
  • Identificar corretamente o tipo e motivo da rescisão;
  • Realizar cálculos e conferências das verbas rescisórias;
  • Atuar com aviso-prévio, saldo de salário, férias, 13º salário e demais verbas aplicáveis;
  • Conferir médias, variáveis, descontos e demais componentes do cálculo;
  • Realizar os procedimentos relacionados ao eSocial;
  • Atuar com FGTS Digital e demais processos relacionados ao desligamento;
  • Conferir documentos e informações antes da finalização;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos prazos legais e internos;
  • Realizar ajustes, correções e retificações quando necessário;
  • Atender colaboradores e gestores em dúvidas relacionadas ao processo de desligamento;
  • Controlar pendências até a conclusão definitiva do processo;
  • Atuar com grande volumetria de rescisões , garantindo qualidade e cumprimento dos prazos;
  • Apoiar a melhoria contínua dos processos de desligamento.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência sólida em Departamento Pessoal;
  • Experiência prática com rescisões em grande volume ;
  • Domínio do processo de desligamento de ponta a ponta ;
  • Conhecimento delegislação trabalhista;
  • Experiência comcálculos e conferência de verbas rescisórias;
  • Conhecimento deeSocial e FGTS Digital;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e extremamente atento aos detalhes;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com alto volume e prazos críticos;
  • Autonomia para identificar inconsistências e solucionar problemas;
  • Boa comunicaçãoe relacionamento com colaboradores e gestores.


⭐ Será um diferencial

Experiência em operações com alto volume de desligamentos , diferentes tipos de rescisão e necessidade de acompanhamento individual das pendências até o encerramento do processo.

Importante: buscamos um profissional que tenha experiência real em conduzir uma rescisão do início ao fim , e não apenas realizar o cálculo no sistema.


Se você domina rescisões, gosta de trabalhar com processos e tem experiência com grande volumetria, candidate-se!


Contratação CLT, 100% presencial na Av. Engenheiro Luís Carlos Berrini, 105

Jornada de trabalho das 08:00 ás 18:00 de seg a quinta e sexta 08:00 ás 17:00


Benefícios:

  • VA e VR - sem desconto
  • VT
  • Seguro de vida
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Plano de saúde e odonto Amil - sem custo ao colaborador
  • PLR
  • Day off no mês de aniversário

title: Coordenador De Planejamento Financeiro E Estratégia
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Esta é uma posição para profissionais que desejam atuar no centro das decisões estratégicas da companhia, sendo responsável por influenciar decisões de investimento de milhões de dólares, apoiar a liderança executiva na definição dos rumos do negócio e atuar diretamente em projetos que impulsionam o crescimento da principal plataformas de infraestrutura digital da América Latina.


Além de trabalhar com temas estratégicos e financeiros de alta relevância, o profissional terá exposição frequente à Diretoria Executiva, ao Conselho de Administração e aos acionistas da companhia, incluindo a Brookfield , uma das maiores gestoras de ativos do mundo, e a Digital Realty , líder global no setor de data centers.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Acompanhamento financeiro dos maiores projetos da companhia, com investimentos que podem superar US$ 1 bilhão .
  • Coordenar os ciclos de orçamento, forecast e planejamento financeiro de Capex e Opex.
  • Desenvolver análises estratégicas e recomendações que apoiem a tomada de decisão dos principais executivos da empresa.
  • Construir cenários financeiros e avaliações de impacto para suportar iniciativas de crescimento, expansão e alocação de capital.
  • Elaborar materiais executivos destinados à Diretoria, Conselho de Administração e Acionistas.
  • Identificar riscos, oportunidades e alavancas de geração de valor, traduzindo dados em recomendações de negocio.
  • Atuar como parceiro de negócio das diferentes áreas da companhia, conectando estratégia, operação e resultado financeiro.
  • Liderar a evolução de indicadores, processos, governança e ferramentas de planejamento.
  • Apoiar a empresa em momentos de transformação, crescimento acelerado e expansão internacional.


O que buscamos

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Planejamento Financeiro, Estratégia Corporativa, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Management Consulting, Business Development ou Corporate Finance.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade de estruturar problemas complexos.
  • Histórico na elaboração de apresentações e materiais para alta liderança.
  • Capacidade de interpretação de modelos financeiros.
  • Excel e PowerPoint avançados.
  • Conhecimento em SQL e ferramentas de analytics será considerado diferencial.
  • Capacidade de influenciar stakeholders e atuar em ambientes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente


Perfil desejado

  • Forte orientação para geração de valor.
  • Pensamento estratégico aliado à capacidade de execução.
  • Curiosidade intelectual e perfil questionador.
  • Facilidade para transformar dados em insights e decisões.
  • Capacidade de comunicação e storytelling executivo.
  • Conforto para atuar em ambientes de alta exposição e elevado grau de responsabilidade.

title: Supervisor(A) De Qualidade E Operações De Transmissões Ao Vivo
description:
City Explorer – Plataforma Global de Livestreaming

⠀Localização: Remoto — São Paulo, Brasil

⠀Salário-base inicial: USD 300 por mês

⠀Disponibilidade: Janela diária de nove horas. O turno exato e os dias de trabalho serão definidos posteriormente.

⠀Idiomas obrigatórios: Português (C2) e inglês (C2)

⠀Espanhol: Será considerado um diferencial

⠀

⠀

VOCÊ CONSEGUE IDENTIFICAR UM PROBLEMA DE QUALIDADE ANTES QUE O PÚBLICO PERCEBA?

⠀Você entende o que torna uma transmissão ao vivo profissional, envolvente e interessante?

⠀Sabe liderar pessoas, dar feedback claro e transformar problemas recorrentes em processos melhores?

⠀A City Explorer está procurando um(a) Supervisor(a) de Qualidade e Operações de Transmissões ao Vivo para assumir a responsabilidade pela qualidade da nossa operação em português.

⠀Esta é uma oportunidade para entrar em uma plataforma internacional em crescimento, trabalhar diretamente com a liderança e participar da construção dos processos que definirão o futuro da nossa operação.

⠀

⠀

SOBRE A CITY EXPLORER

⠀A City Explorer é uma plataforma global que conecta pessoas e culturas por meio de experiências autênticas transmitidas em tempo real.

⠀Todos os dias, nossos Explorers mostram cidades, ruas, culturas, paisagens, negócios e situações do cotidiano para espectadores de diferentes partes do mundo.

⠀Eles recebem equipamentos profissionais, treinamento estruturado e acompanhamento de uma equipe internacional de coaches.

⠀À medida que a plataforma cresce, a qualidade das transmissões precisa crescer junto. Por isso, buscamos alguém capaz de manter padrões elevados e ajudar coaches e Explorers a melhorar continuamente.

⠀

⠀

SUA MISSÃO

⠀Sua missão será simples e importante:

⠀Tornar cada transmissão melhor.

⠀Você coordenará coaches, acompanhará a qualidade das transmissões, identificará problemas recorrentes e garantirá que os Explorers recebam orientações claras, úteis e consistentes.

⠀Você será o principal ponto de conexão entre nossos Explorers de língua portuguesa, a equipe de coaches e a liderança da City Explorer.

⠀Esta é uma função prática para alguém que gosta de assumir responsabilidades, resolver problemas e gerar melhorias visíveis e mensuráveis.

⠀

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Coordenar e apoiar os coaches responsáveis pelos Explorers de língua portuguesa
  • Monitorar a qualidade técnica, a apresentação e a experiência do público
  • Garantir que os coaches forneçam feedback claro, construtivo e consistente
  • Identificar problemas recorrentes e acompanhar sua resolução
  • Estabelecer e manter padrões de qualidade
  • Apoiar o onboarding e o desenvolvimento de coaches e Explorers
  • Melhorar processos de monitoramento, comunicação e relatórios
  • Acompanhar o desempenho e identificar áreas que exigem atenção
  • Encaminhar problemas técnicos ou operacionais graves para a liderança
  • Trabalhar diretamente com a direção da City Explorer
  • Ajudar a construir sistemas de qualidade que possam crescer com a plataforma

⠀

O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS ⠀

  • Português em nível C2 ou nativo
  • Inglês em nível C2 ou proficiência profissional equivalente
  • Experiência com liderança, supervisão ou coordenação de equipes
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Segurança para orientar pessoas e avaliar desempenho
  • Forte capacidade de organização e resolução de problemas
  • Alto nível de atenção aos detalhes
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões e assumir responsabilidade pelos resultados
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com diferentes países e fusos horários
  • Capacidade de administrar várias prioridades
  • Interesse genuíno por livestreaming, mídia digital e experiência do público


EXPERIÊNCIA VALORIZADA

Será valorizada experiência em uma ou mais destas áreas:⠀

  • Transmissões ao vivo
  • Mídia digital ou broadcasting
  • Produção de conteúdo
  • Gestão de criadores ou talentos
  • Coaching ou treinamento
  • Controle de qualidade
  • Experiência do cliente
  • Supervisão de equipes remotas
  • Gestão de operações


COMO SERÁ O SUCESSO NESTA FUNÇÃO? ⠀

  • Nos primeiros três meses, esperamos que você ajude a alcançar:⠀
  • Feedback mais claro e consistente por parte dos coaches
  • Melhoria visível na qualidade das transmissões em português
  • Identificação mais rápida de problemas técnicos e de apresentação
  • Resolução mais eficiente de problemas recorrentes
  • Maior clareza para os Explorers sobre os padrões esperados
  • Relatórios de qualidade mais úteis para a liderança


POR QUE TRABALHAR NA CITY EXPLORER? ⠀

  • Assuma uma função importante dentro de uma plataforma global
  • Coordene e apoie uma equipe internacional de coaches
  • Trabalhe diretamente com a liderança da empresa
  • Ajude a desenvolver novos sistemas e processos
  • Veja o impacto real das suas decisões
  • Trabalhe remotamente com profissionais de diferentes países
  • Tenha acesso a revisões salariais por desempenho e oportunidades de crescimento a partir do terceiro mês
  • Cresça junto com uma plataforma em expansão internacional


SALÁRIO E DISPONIBILIDADE

⠀O salário-base inicial é de USD 300 por mês .

⠀A função exige uma janela diária de disponibilidade de nove horas .

⠀O turno, os dias de trabalho e a cobertura de fusos horários serão discutidos e definidos durante o processo seletivo.

⠀A primeira avaliação de desempenho será realizada a partir do terceiro mês, com possibilidade de progressão salarial e aumento de responsabilidades.

⠀

⠀

COMO SE CANDIDATAR

⠀As candidaturas serão analisadas continuamente.

⠀

Envie uma breve apresentação incluindo:⠀

  • Sua experiência profissional relevante
  • Sua experiência com liderança, coaching ou coordenação de equipes
  • Qualquer experiência com livestreaming, mídia, conteúdo ou operações
  • Sua disponibilidade atual
  • Seu nível de português e inglês
  • Por que você acredita ser a pessoa certa para esta função


Se você está pronto(a) para assumir responsabilidades, liderar pessoas e elevar a qualidade das transmissões de uma plataforma internacional em crescimento, queremos conhecer você.

title: Finance Manager
description:
When you join GAR, you join something bigger. Big in scale, big in opportunities to grow, and big in impact. With over 100,000 employees across 14 countries, spanning Asia, Europe, North America, and South America, Golden Agri-Resources (GAR) is one of the largest agribusinesses in the world. We manage over half a million hectares of palm oil plantations, including smallholder farms, across Indonesia. But our size is only part of the story. Since 1997, we’ve put sustainability at the centre of how we grow, working hand-in-hand with farmers, communities, and partners to deliver food, fuel, and a better future.

We’re a seed-to-shelf business rooted in palm oil, now expanding across other essential crops like sugar, soybean, sunflower, and coconut.

Our people are our edge. We invest in them through global opportunities, cross-border exposure, and continuous learning, because growing a better business starts with growing our people.

Here, your career feeds something meaningful for the planet, people, and generations to come


We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to join our team in São Paulo, Brazil. In this role, you will oversee all aspects of finance, accounting, tax, legal, IT, and treasury, including financial reporting, budgeting, taxation, cash management, and statutory compliance. You will be responsible for maintaining the full set of ledgers and accounts, managing monthly closing activities, preparing financial and statutory reports, ensuring compliance with applicable local, international, and internal accounting and tax standards, and supporting the timely and accurate consolidation of financial information for Head Office. As a business partner, you will provide data-driven insights to support decision-making and play a key role in building systems, processes, and frameworks from scratch, particularly across finance, tax, legal, and treasury. This is a highly hands-on role, especially during the initial phase, requiring you to personally execute and/or review key finance processes such as payments, bank reconciliations, tax calculations, invoicing, accounting entries, and month-end closing. We are looking for someone who is proactive, improvement-oriented, and solution-driven, with strong analytical and organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and a collaborative mindset. The ideal candidate will also have the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams while working effectively in a dynamic and growing environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain all accounting records in the ERP system to ensure accuracy of the general ledger and financial accounts.
  • Lead the monthly and annual financial closing processes through the preparation of standard reports as well as other custom reports as requested.
  • Review and analyse financial statements/records and provide reports and data analysis to various internal stakeholders.
  • Manage day-to-day risk exposures, -reports and -mitigation measures such as insurances, hedges etc. Work with credit team to manage counterpart exposures and follow up on overdue receivables.
  • Ensure adequate liquidity to support the business, support/investigate/expand local or central funding opportunities.
  • Lead the transition of the bookkeeping from external service providers to "in-house".
  • Ensure desired IT platform and relevant key procedures will be implemented.
  • Coordinate and assist finance department in Brazil with the financial record keeping of the activities undertaken in Brazil.
  • Oversee local administrative matters and purchase office supplies and equipment while maintaining appropriate stock levels in a cost-efficient manner.
  • Manage and execute all payments and customer invoicing, including entering payment instructions into the online banking system and coordinating the required approvals to ensure payments are released accurately and within the established deadlines.
  • Prepare and process cash claims and expense reimbursements for the Brazilian team.
  • Advise and assist various departments on accounting, tax and legal compliance by researching and ensuring compliance to applicable internal, national and international rules and regulations.
  • Coordinate external / internal audits and prepare audit requirements.
  • Liaise with central teams in Singapore / Jakarta for ad-hoc queries and analysis requests.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for office managers, IT teams, auditors, accountants, finance managers, and HR teams across other locations in the EU and Americas regions.
  • Act as the first point of contact for external stakeholders such as banks, legal, tax authorities and other regulatory bodies, service providers.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 8+ years’ relevant experience in accounting, finance and trade control
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian and international accounting, tax and regulatory requirements.
  • Working experience in the Commodity industry
  • Experience with tax, legal, banking
  • Experience with implementing IT systems and consolidation work
  • Proficient with MS Office
  • Experience with ERP software (SAP is an advantage)
  • Experience working in an international environment
  • Experience building & leading a high performing team
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
  • Fluent in Spanish, both written and spoken is preferred

We Offer

  • An entrepreneurial and international environment where developing opportunities for growth is valued
  • Training opportunities, locally and globally
  • Health insurance
  • Meal support (vale refeição)
  • Transport support/Parking lot (Vale transporte ou vaga de estacionamento)


Please note that we may incorporate an assessment and reference checks in our selection procedures.

title: Overseas Pre-Sales Engineer-Brazil
description:
Responsibility：

Solution Development and Customization：

  • Communicate deeply with customers (commercial enterprises, industrial customers, agricultural cooperatives or government agencies) to evaluate their energy needs (such as cost reduction, renewable energy integration or grid stability).
  • Work with internal technical teams to design and propose customized solutions, such as 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems, battery backup (BESS) or hybrid energy projects.
  • Integrate photovoltaic, energy storage or other technologies according to the customer's specific application scenarios (such as peak shaving, off-grid power supply or frequency regulation services) to ensure the absorption and competitiveness of the solution.

Sales and Business Development：

  • Develop and implement solutions sales strategies to achieve company revenue targets, especially in the fast-growing distributed PV and energy storage market in Brazil.
  • Identify potential customers and sales opportunities, and proactively promote company products and services, such as solutions for the southeast region with high electricity prices or the northeast region with abundant solar resources.
  • Convert potential customers into actual orders by demonstrating technical advantages and return on investment (ROI).

Bridging technology and business

  • Explain the technical details of the solution to customers (such as PV system efficiency, energy storage discharge time) and translate them into business language (cost savings, revenue improvement).
  • Prepare and present professional sales proposals, including technical specifications, financial models (such as payback period calculation) and project benefit analysis.
  • Submit high-quality proposals on behalf of the company and participate in negotiations in bidding or competition (such as the 2025 energy storage auction).

Customer Relationship and After-Sales Support

  • Serve as the customer's primary contact to ensure smooth progress from solution design to project delivery, and provide technical consultation and support.
  • Follow up the progress of project implementation, coordinate with the engineering team, and solve problems that arise during installation or operation.
  • Provide after-sales service suggestions (such as system upgrades, maintenance plans) to promote long-term cooperation and upsell.

Market Analysis and Product Feedback

  • Monitor Brazilian energy market trends, such as policy changes (Law 14.300, ANEEL Energy Storage Specifications), competitor dynamics, and customer demand changes.
  • Collect customer feedback and work with product development teams to optimize solutions (such as increasing storage capacity or reducing costs).
  • Report market insights to management regularly and recommend new product or service directions.

Cross-departmental collaboration

  • Work closely with the technical team to ensure that the solution complies with Brazilian grid standards (such as ONS requirements) and customer expectations.
  • Coordinate with the finance department to provide financing options (such as BNDES loans or installments) to help customers overcome financial barriers.
  • Liaise with procurement and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery of equipment (such as PV modules, batteries).

Training and knowledge sharing

  • Provide technical training to sales teams or customers to explain the working principles and advantages of photovoltaic and energy storage systems.
  • Participate in industry events (such as energy exhibitions) to showcase company solutions and build brand influence.


Requirement：

Preferred:

  • Direct experience in the field of photovoltaics or energy storage, such as selling 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems or battery energy storage solutions.
  • Participation in project development in the Brazilian market, such as distributed generation or grid integration projects.

description:

title: Pessoa Estagiária De Engenharia - Indicadores
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Coordenação do time de Marketing e elaboração do planejamento estratégico anual;

  • Acompanhamento da evolução dos principais KPIs da área, com foco em otimização e rentabilização dos resultados;
  • Busca por parcerias estratégicas e desenvolvimento contínuo de melhores práticas e inovações do mercado;
  • Gerenciamento do planejamento, junto da agência de mídia nacional e assessoria de imprensa;
  • Desenvolvimentode projetos especiais focados em implementação de novas frentes de trabalho, prospecção de eventos, captação de patrocínio;
  • Acompanhamento,mapeamento e implementação de melhorias dentro da vertical de mídia no shopping;
  • Gerenciamento da performance de mídia paga e CRM, Programas de benefícios do shopping, envolvendo definição da objetivos, estratégia, implementação, acompanhamento, relatório de resultados e KPIs estratégicos.

description:

Buscamos um(a) estagiário(a) para integrar o time de Marketing e atuar em todo o ciclo de produção de vídeo da empresa, da ideia à publicação. Você vai participar da criação de conteúdo institucional e para redes sociais, trabalhando lado a lado com a equipe de marketing e aprendendo na prática as etapas de pré-produção, captação, edição e pós-produção.

- Pós-produção: finalizar e exportar os vídeos nos formatos adequados a cada plataforma, fazer ajustes de cor e áudio, além de organizar, nomear e manter backup dos arquivos brutos e editados.

- Apoiar o time de marketing em demandas gerais de conteúdo e cobertura de eventos internos.

title: Inside Sales Manager
description:
Kaspersky has been protecting individuals and corporate clients all over the world from cyber threats for 29 years.


We have 400 million unique users, 270 000 corporate clients, 517 products, 1100 technological patents and 34 offices around the world. Today our team has more than 5 500 top level experts, all of them regular people with their own talents and hobbies.


Together we protect the world from cyber threats.


Join us to become part of an exceptional team, while remaining yourself and using your skills to keep us growing and evolving.


Kaspersky is looking for an Inside Sales Manager to drive SMB sales growth in Brazil by developing relationships with customers and channel partners and identifying new business opportunities. This role is responsible for managing sales pipelines, supporting partners throughout the sales cycle, positioning Kaspersky solutions and value proposition, and helping to win deals against the competition.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Consistently meet or exceed sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory;
  • Drive SMB salesthrough channel partners, including new business, renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities;
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with partners and SMB customers;
  • Identify, assess and develop new business opportunities and prospective customers;
  • Manage and progress sales pipelines, ensuring accurate forecasting and execution against business goals;
  • Promote and clearly articulate Kaspersky’s value proposition and competitive advantages to partners and customers;
  • Recruit, train and enable partners to effectively position and sell Kaspersky solutions;
  • Balance farmingand hunting activities by developing existing accounts while acquiring new customers;
  • Conduct regularfollow-ups and coordinate with partners to support deal progression and increase win rates;
  • Work closely with Sales, Channel and Marketing teams on joint sales and marketing activities;
  • Support webinars, events, product demonstrations and other activities aimed at generating demand and business opportunities;
  • Maintain accurate documentation of sales activities, partner engagements and opportunities.


Required Experience, Skills and Competencies:


  • 5–8 years of experience in Sales, Account Management or Business Development within the technology industry;
  • Strong understanding of the full sales cycle and experience managing sales pipelines and business opportunities;
  • Experience selling technology solutions, services or complex projects based on customer needs and business value;
  • Experience in both new business development and existing account management;
  • Experience working with customers and channel partners;
  • Strong sales and business development skills with a focus on achieving revenue targets;
  • Strong communication, relationship management and stakeholder management skills;
  • Ability to clearly articulate and position a value proposition to customers and partners;
  • Strong teamworkand cross-functional collaboration skills;
  • Problem-solvingand conflict-resolution skills;
  • Result-orientedmindset;
  • Fluent English.

Coordenar as operações e os programas de Saúde Corporativa, por meio da gestão dos processos assistenciais e ocupacionais, indicadores, equipe e iniciativas de promoção à saúde, visando a manter a qualidade dos serviços, cumprir os requisitos legais e regulatórios e promover o cuidado integral e a qualidade de vida dos colaboradores.

  • Planejar programas e ações de promoção da saúde, prevenção de doenças, saúde mental e qualidade de vida, com base no perfil epidemiológico e nas necessidades dos colaboradores, a fim de promover o bem-estar e reduzir riscos relacionados à saúde;

title: 3d Character Animator
description:
3D Character Animator - Indie Platform Fighter

I'm looking to hire an experienced 3D Character Animator to help bring the fighters in an upcoming indie platform fighter to life.

The game is a fast-paced, combat-focused platform fighter featuring gods, deities, and religious figures from different traditions battling one another. I'm looking for someone who can create dynamic, highly readable, hard-hitting combat animation , with attacks that feel powerful, responsive, expressive, and satisfying in gameplay.

What I'm Looking For

Required

  • Strong professional portfolio demonstrating 3D character animation
  • Ideally 5–10+ years of 3D animation experience
  • Experience working on indie games or other real-time game projects
  • Excellent understanding of:
  • Combat animation
  • Body mechanics
  • Weight and momentum
  • Timing, anticipation, follow-through, and impact
  • Exaggerated poses and readable silhouettes
  • Ability to create everything from quick jabs and movement animations to large, epic special attacks and finishing moves
  • Understanding of the technical constraints of animation for real-time gameplay
  • Comfortable iterating based on how animations actually feel in-game

Strongly Preferred

  • Cascadeur
  • Blender
  • Unity
  • Experience exporting animation assets and implementing/testing them inside Unity
Bonus Skills

I'd especially love to find someone capable of handling more of the full 3D character pipeline , including:

  • Retopology (for minor clean-up work)
  • UV unwrapping
  • Texturing
  • Rigging (especially for animals, or characters with multiple arms or wings)
  • Weight painting
  • Character and animal animation
  • Preparing/exporting characters and animations for Unity
  • Troubleshooting rigs, meshes, animation clips, and import settings

These additional skills are a major plus, but animation is the priority . If you're an exceptional combat animator who specializes specifically in animation, I still want to hear from you.

The Project

This is an indie platform fighter built around a roster of mythological and religious characters, with an intentionally comedic, irreverent, and satirical tone.

Important: The game contains deliberately blasphemous and sacrilegious humor and jokes about gods, religions, religious beliefs, and religious figures. Applicants need to be genuinely comfortable working on that kind of material.

Who Would Be a Great Fit

I'm looking for someone who:

  • Loves making combat animation feel ridiculously satisfying
  • Understands that gameplay readability matters as much as beautiful animation
  • Can exaggerate movement without making it feel weightless
  • Is comfortable working collaboratively and iterating quickly
  • Has experience with small or independent game-development teams
  • Can take a relatively simple stylized character and give them a huge amount of personality through movement
  • If you've worked on a fighting game, platform fighter, action game, or anything involving exaggerated character combat, I'd especially like to see it.

title: Analista Fp&A Júnior
description:

A Piadina Romagnola é o resultado de um sonho antigo de construir uma empresa no ramo da alimentação. Nela oferecemos um sanduíche delicioso e tradicional, a Piadina, muito mais saudável e equilibrado que as opções mais comuns. Fundada em 2012 com a primeira unidade no Morumbi Shopping, atua hoje em 15 unidades localizadas em alguns do melhores pontos da cidade de São Paulo, atendendo cerca de 80.000 clientes/mês.

Tanto na Cumbuca quanto na Piadina nossa missão é uma só: encantar nossos clientes todos os dias através de uma alimentação deliciosa, saudável e prática.

Nossos principais ingredientes são amor e carinho.

Cultivamos um ambiente onde todos constroem juntos.

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe ambição

Não temos limite pra crescer

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabem todos os sonhos do mundo

Se você sonha com um mundo mais saudável, vem sonhar com a gente!

Basic Functions and Responsibilities includes, but are not limited to:


▪ To coordinate the preparation, review, approval, and maintenance of all Intrials

Quality Management System (QMS) documentation, including SOPs, Policies, and

other controlled documents, as required.

trials conducted by Intrials are performed in compliance with applicable regulations,

ICH-GCP guidelines, study protocols, and Intrials' or Sponsor's (SOPs).

▪ To prepare the Vendor Qualification process according to Intrials’s SOP and client

expectations (internal and external).

▪ To plan, coordinate, and participate in internal and external audits, sponsor audits,

and regulatory inspections, providing quality support before, during, and after the

audit or inspection process if applicable.

▪ To coordinate the onboarding quality process for new employees, ensuring

completion of mandatory Quality Management System and GxP training

requirements.

▪ To manage the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring its maintenance,

continuous improvement, and compliance with applicable regulations and company

procedures.

▪ To act as System Owner for the electronic Quality Management System, ensuring

its proper administration, maintenance, user support, and compliance with validated

state requirements.

▪ To support the validation and lifecycle management of computerized GxP systems,

ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal

procedures.

▪ To manage the deviation process, including deviation review, investigation

oversight, root cause analysis, CAPA definition, and effectiveness follow-up.

compliance, quality processes, and regulatory requirements.


Primary Activities includes, but are not limited to:

assessments, vendor audits, audit reporting, and ongoing performance monitoring

in accordance with Intrials' Quality Management System (QMS) and applicable

regulatory requirements.

including site audits, Trial Master File (TMF) audits, process audits, and vendor

and contractual quality requirements.

▪ To manage and continuously improve the Intrials Quality Management System

applicable regulations, ICH-GCP E6(R3), and industry best practices.

▪ To develop, review, maintain, and implement controlled quality documents,

including SOPs, Policies, Work Instructions, templates, and other QMS

documentation.

▪ To develop and deliver GCP and Quality Management training programs, ensuring

personnel maintain the competencies required for their assigned responsibilities.

▪ To promote a culture of continuous improvement by identifying quality risks,

analyzing quality metrics and trends, recommending process improvements, and

supporting the implementation of risk-based quality management initiatives.

GCP requirements by participating in professional development activities, training

programs, and scientific meetings, applying acquired knowledge to strengthen the

▪ To coordinate the Quality onboarding process for new employees, ensuring

assignment and completion of mandatory training within established timelines.

▪ To manage deviations, non-conformities and quality events, including review of

investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA implementation and effectiveness

verification.

compliance with company procedures and regulatory expectations.

▪ To perform periodic monitoring and trending analysis of Quality Management

System metrics and quality indicators.

▪ To act as System Owner for the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS),

▪ To support periodic reviews of validated computerized systems to ensure continued

  • Assist with the creation of purchase orders in the ERP system, as well as with payment requests and follow-up throughout the process.

title: Supervisor De Contas A Receber
description:
About the Company

CMA CGM is one of the world’s leading transportation and logistics groups, operating across global markets and connecting businesses through integrated maritime, land, and air solutions. The Group is committed to innovation, operational excellence, sustainability, and the continuous development of its people and business.


Job Description

We are looking for an Accounts Receivable Supervisor to lead the company’s accounts receivable and collection activities, ensuring that revenues are accurately and timely collected while maintaining appropriate credit policies and terms.


This position plays a key role in improving cash flow, managing credit and collection processes, reducing financial and operational risks, and strengthening relationships with internal and external stakeholders.


Our opportunities are inclusive and open to professionals with disabilities (PwD).


Mission

The professional will be responsible for overseeing the Accounts Receivable function, ensuring effective credit management, collection performance, and cash flow optimization. The role will lead the team, monitor key performance indicators, identify risks and improvement opportunities, and ensure compliance with internal policies and Group procedures.


Main Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Define targets, provide the necessary resources, and manage team performance;
  • Develop and support team members to maximize individual and collective performance;
  • Ensure the teamhas the appropriate skills and profile for the area;
  • Oversee communication, instructions, and performance of outsourced collection partners;
  • Monitor productivity, quality, and target achievement across the team.


Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Develop and implement strategic objectives to improve cash flow and manage DSO;
  • Manage credit terms and ensure compliance with established policies and procedures;
  • Assess and approve credit within established authorization limits, supporting the CFO in credit assessments when required;
  • Manage collection activities performed by internal teams and outsourced collection companies;
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate financial and operational risks;
  • Ensure accuratereconciliation of accounts receivable balances in partnership with the Accounting team;
  • Maintain accurate records, reports, and performance information for key stakeholders;
  • Monitor KPIs and implement corrective actions whenever necessary;
  • Review and improve processes and procedures to enhance collection results and operational efficiency.


Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with Commercial and Invoicing teams to accelerate collections and strengthen customer relationships;
  • Partner with Finance, Customer Service, Legal, and Operations to resolve accounts receivable issues;
  • Support internal and external customers by negotiating solutions to outstanding issues;
  • Provide effective solutions to meet business requirements and customer needs;
  • Maintain stakeholders informed through accurate and controlled reports and information;
  • Act as a transversal business partner across different functions to improve cash flow and customer relationships.


Management Scope

  • Leadership of a large team of 7 employees;
  • Management of internal and outsourced collection activities;
  • Coordination ofprojects and initiatives related to credit and collections;
  • Interaction with senior management and cross-functional stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities & Expected Results

The Accounts Receivable Supervisor will be expected to maintain strong performance against the organization’s KPIs, ensuring that accounts receivable remains under control and that collection targets are consistently achieved.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA is considered a plus;
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in credit authorization and accounts receivable/collection practices;
  • Previous experience in an Accounts Receivable leadership position;
  • Advanced Excel skills;
  • Knowledge of SAP is considered a plus;
  • Fluent English;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills;
  • Strong negotiation and problem-solving capabilities.


Key Competencies

Leadership | Financial Acumen | Results Orientation | Planning | Assertiveness | Teamwork | Negotiation | Problem Solving | Transversality | Conflict Management


Join Our Team!


Be part of a global organization where your expertise will contribute to improving cash flow, strengthening customer relationships, driving operational excellence, and supporting sustainable business growth.

title: Purchasing Manager
description:
Responsible for the management of the purchasing team of direct materials in the automotive sector, ensuring the efficient supply of components. It acts as a facilitator between global suppliers and internal teams to ensure competitiveness, innovation, technical compliance and supply chain sustainability. Will be responsible for Supplier quality, Purchasing controlling, direct material management short and long term, support new developments. Must be capable to handle environment with very high complexity and high resilience to pressure. Budget 170M$USD


Responsabilities:

  • Define and execute sourcing strategies for categories of direct automotive materials, aligned with the company's global plan;
  • Manage the relationship with Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers, ensuring performance in quality, cost, delivery and technological innovation (QCDI);
  • Conduct technical and commercial negotiations, ensuring long-term competitive contracts;
  • Work together with Engineering, Quality, Logistics and Projects to ensure the time-to-market of product launches and changes;
  • Mitigate risks in the supply chain (disruptions, obsolescence, geopolitical crises, etc.);
  • Constantly seekopportunities to reduce costs and increase efficiency, including Design-to-Cost and Make-or-Buy initiatives;
  • Manage the financial results of the area, supporting and implementing projects with the purpose of reducing operating costs, in order to meet goals foreseen in the company's budget.
  • Lead supplier audits, technical/commercial feasibility analyses and approvals of new partners;
  • Manage and monitor performance indicators (KPIs) and effectively ensure the delivery of strategic procurement objectives;
  • Develop and lead cross-functional teams, promoting a culture of high performance, compliance and innovation in accordance with the company's values.
  • Manage the human resources allocated in their area, evaluating and/or analyzing the results of individual performance, defining and guiding training and professional development actions, requesting functional and salary changes, keeping them informed about the company's policies, rules and regulations, aiming at integration and organization and appreciation of personnel.
  • Support the implementation of new projects within the established levels of quality, training, productivity, adherence and operational costs, participating in their planning and development.
  • Participate in the strategic planning of the Unit and ensure the execution of the established actions.
  • Guide employees to follow corporate procedures and environmental and safety management systems, through Work Instructions.
  • Build a good work environment, aiming at improving the indexes related to the climate survey, through management tools.
  • Manage daily requirements to support plant smooth operations and no impact on customers such as quality, delivery, commercial, development among others.
  • Propose modifications in the organizational and functional structures of the section, due to the expansion, reduction or rationalization of the area's activities and/or incorporation of new technologies, studying the changes together with other internal areas, preparing reports and submitting them to superior appreciation, in order to adapt them to the company's needs.


Requirements:


Education: Complete higher education in Engineering, Administration, Foreign Trade or related areas

Desirable Degree of Education: Postgraduate


Language: Fluent English

Other languages are a differential (e.G., Spanish);


Experience: Over 10 years in the activities of the position.

Consolidated experience in purchasing direct materials in the automotive sector (OEMs or systemists);


Other Knowledge:

  • Mastery of Strategic Sourcing processes, international negotiation and contract management;
  • Technical knowledge of automotive components and their value chains;
  • Familiarity with ERP systems (preferably QAD/SAP), cost analysis tools and Lean methodologies;
  • Strategic, analytical, resilient profile, with excellent communication and decision-making skills under pressure.

title: Talent Acquisition Recruiter (Temporary 6 Months)
description:
This is a contractor position to provide services to a global company based in Brazil

  • Develop and execute recruitment and sourcing strategies that align with business objectives and workforce planning needs.

  • Provide full-cycle recruiting support, including job posting creation, candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, offer management, and onboarding coordination.

  • Leverage recruitment technologies, analytics, and reporting tools to improve recruiting effectiveness, optimize processes, and drive continuous improvement.

  • Participate in talent acquisition projects, initiatives, and process enhancements that improve the candidate and hiring manager experience.
  • Build and maintain productive relationships with hiring managers, HR professionals, candidates, and external partners.
  • Provide guidance on recruitment best practices, talent market trends, candidate assessment approaches, and workforce insights.
  • Foster engagement within talent communities to support current and future hiring needs.
  • Support training and knowledge sharing related to recruiting processes, systems, and tools.
  • Collaborate in the evaluation and management of recruitment vendors and external partners when applicable.
  • Ensure recruitment activities comply with company policies, employment regulations, labor laws, and applicable regional requirements.
  • Support governance processes, documentation requirements, reporting activities, and compliance initiatives to ensure a consistent and equitable hiring process.


Who You Are:


You anticipate customer needs and provide solutions that exceed expectations. You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. You use data, insights, and sound judgment to make quality decisions, even in complex situations. You adapt your approach when priorities change and remain effective in evolving environments while maintaining focus on delivering results.


For This Role, You Will Need:


  • Experience managing full-cycle recruitment activities, including sourcing, assessment, selection, and offer processes for Brazilian market
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience.
  • Professional proficiency in English and Portuguese
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to build effective partnerships with stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.
  • Ability to gather, analyze, interpret, and communicate data-driven insights and recommendations.
  • Knowledge of employment practices, labor regulations, equitable hiring principles, and inclusive recruitment strategies.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality results.
  • Experience driving process consistency and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Excellent relationship-building, communication, and customer service skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively with hiring managers, candidates, and cross-functional partners.
  • Experience using applicant tracking systems, sourcing platforms, and recruitment technologies, such as Oracle Recruiting Cloud, LinkedIn, or similar tools.


Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:


  • Training or certification in behavioral interviewing, candidate assessment, or talent acquisition best practices.
  • Experience recruiting for technical, specialized, or professional roles.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
  • Experience analyzing recruiting metrics and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage recruitment data accurately and efficiently.
  • Experience supporting recruitment initiatives across multiple business units, functions, or geographic regions.

title: Coordenador De Filial - Concessionária Linha Pesada
description:
Descrição

Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais 20 pontos do país, atendendo a 06 estados diferentes, sendo Equipo - RJ, Itaipu - MG, Itaipu Norte - PA, Quinta Roda - SP e Supermac - AM e RR.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos e produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética.

Com essa aquisição, a WLM amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A localização estratégica das unidades permite uma atuação com abrangente cobertura geográfica, garantindo presteza, qualidade e agilidade no atendimento.

A sua holding está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e possui uma filial corporativa em Minas Gerais, na Cidade de Contagem.


Sua missão:

  • Desenvolver estratégias e planos de ação voltados ao crescimento de receita, produtividade e rentabilidade.
  • Alavancar vendas de serviços, ampliando ticket médio e mix de serviços.

  • Gerir indicadores, processos, custos, qualidade e desempenho da operação.
  • Otimizar recursos materiais e financeiros, com gestão eficiente e atitude de dono.
  • Desenvolver e engajar equipes, promovendo cultura de resultado, disciplina e excelência.
  • Implementar cultura de feedback contínuo e PDI, construir times de alta performance e zelar pelo bem-estar e segurança da equipe.
  • Monitorar o clima organizacional e implementar ações que aumentem satisfação e engajamento.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as demais áreas, garantindo agilidade e eficiência operacional.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Administração, Gestão Comercial, Logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com liderança de equipe em ambiente de oficina.
  • Conhecimento técnico em manutenção automotiva pesada.
  • Boa comunicação e postura comercial.


Vantagens/Benefícios:
